engine.scope: real engine source to object; no final link; PCHs built separately with target compiler flags; no source or build inputs modified

limitations: One native Linux host and Clang toolchain; background load and CPU frequency varied.
Engine timings are source-to-object with separately prepared PCHs, not executable links or full clean engine builds.
Game timings are one source edit through executable link; cold means game PCH/objects/link, with engine/dependencies built.
Maximum RSS is the largest single process, not aggregate concurrent memory.
Published reproducers add output/clean-worktree guards and normalize the engine control by removing explicit filesystem/chrono includes; measured baseline had neither include.
Failed harness setup collected no samples and is excluded; original build artifacts were restored before valid measurements.
